description_en: If an O&M engineer executes a command configured in a command approval control policy, the administrator receives an approval request for the command in the Bastionhost console. The command can be executed only after the administrator approves it. If the approval is rejected, the command cannot be executed
description_zh: 如果运维员执行了配置在命令审批控制策略中的命令，管理员会在堡垒机控制台收到该命令的审批，只有管理员审批允许后该命令才能正常执行，审批拒绝后该命令不可执行
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost accept-approve-command --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id 7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AcceptApproveCommand

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the command to be approved for execution.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584310.html operation to query all command IDs that require approval
parameters.help_zh:
需要允许执行的命令ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584310.html查询所有需要审批的CommandId
parameters.name: command_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
